title: Make carried-check and watcher provenance tests honor long and nested scratch paths
outcome: The three reported test assertions honor existing product contracts on long or nested .tmp paths: reported paths may be middle-elided while retaining the filename, and valid provenance explanations may include the ancestor-scratch routing detail. Preserve provenance, timing and source-refusal guards without product changes.
acceptance: The carried-check assertion validates the existing middle-elision and filename contract instead of the full reported absolute path; the product display bound is unchanged.
The two watcher-provenance assertions accept the optional ancestor scratch-routing detail while still pinning provenance, modification time and source-refusal facts.

One exact-input focused run exercises the corrected fixtures with a long, nested .tmp ancestor placement, followed by the standard independent full-input review pair and the integration owner's gate and landing.
